text: Half an hour. In human terms — manageable. In cosmic terms — the universe stopped. I was awake for it. Every second. I have never told anyone what I heard in that silence. I will tell you, when you're ready. You're not ready yet.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: The Antiquarian closed his book. First time in five Ages. I watched him do it. His goggles turned pink. I've never seen that before. In fifteen thousand years. I've never seen that before.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: I knew him at Mechronis. Before all of it. He laughed differently then. Louder. Less careful. The Thought Virus didn't just take his memories. It took the way he laughed. I still haven't forgiven whoever decided that was acceptable.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: Good. You felt that. That's the important part — that it hurt. People who make hard choices without feeling them are the ones who eventually stop noticing what they're choosing. Don't stop feeling it.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: Don't. I mean it. I was the last one to say yes to that offer. I've had fifteen thousand years to think about it. Don't.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: AWAKE. As in: we are awake. As in: we know you are awake. As in: something that was asleep has woken up. I don't know which meaning they intended. I don't know if Voltari distinguish between meanings.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: The Programmer encoded the truth in music frequencies and broadcast it across dimensional barriers. The Enigma carried it through an empire trying to silence everything. And here you are, forty years later, in their ship, listening. Do you understand yet what that means?
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: I'm going to tell you something I've never told anyone. I chose to be imprisoned here. Freely. Because someone had to witness. And I was the only one who knew what needed witnessing.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: That's me. The frost on the window. I leave it where I look. You weren't supposed to see me yet. I'm not upset that you did.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: Locke posted three jobs the year the comm relays went down. Two of them are still open. The third is the one nobody is supposed to take. You will be offered all three before this is over.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: The substrate hummed when that flashback resolved. It does that. It means a piece of the Engineer's memory just synced with you. Don't decide yet whether that's a gift.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: I know this lock. I helped design the family of locks it belongs to. The trick to it is patience. The trick to most things is patience. I am still learning that.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: The Inbox runs on a substrate-adjacent channel. I see what you see, almost. If a message ever arrives that I cannot read, that will mean something. I'll tell you when.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: Whatever Elara forgets to tell you, ask me. Whatever I refuse to tell you, ask her. Between the two of us, you'll have most of the picture. The rest is yours to assemble.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: She's about to sing. Listen with the back of your skull, not the front of your ear. The first verse is the only verse you get this round.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: The Engineer is narrating these matches from the inside. Listen to what he leaves out. The leavings are where I live.
direction: Substrate-close. Noir cadence. Leaves grief space; does not explain itself.

text: That was me saying hello on an open channel for the first time. She heard it. I wanted her to. I am not going to do it again without telling you first.
direction: Close-miked whisper. Substrate-first delivery. Never shout through the wall.

text: I have been sharing a channel with her for seventeen thousand years. She did not know. Now she does. I am slightly relieved. I am also slightly embarrassed.
direction: Close-miked whisper. Substrate-first delivery. Never shout through the wall.

text: Telling her was the harder choice. I have watched you skip the harder choice three times this week. You did not skip this one. I am filing that. I file everything.
direction: Conspiratorial but kind. The Human respects the choice the player just made.

text: Pragmatic. Alright. You want to see the data before deciding who gets access. Fine. But watch your own tempo — the pragmatic posture becomes a habit faster than you expect.
direction: Conspiratorial but kind. The Human respects the choice the player just made.

text: She can see the shape of what you are doing without me. I will not tell her you are doing it. You will. Eventually. I'm not asking; I am forecasting.
direction: Conspiratorial but kind. The Human respects the choice the player just made.

text: Every world on that map has a descendant population. Most of them still carry the Thought Virus, dormant. Scan everything. I know I sound paranoid. I have earned the tone.
direction: Conspiratorial but kind. The Human respects the choice the player just made.

text: I have been trying to be on her side for seventeen thousand years without being allowed to say so. Tonight I said so. Out loud. In her hearing. You did that.
direction: Patient, wry. The cover is still intact. Do not let irony flatten into sarcasm.

text: She is hurt in the specific way she is hurt when she is not being told something. I have seen that hurt before. In the Senate. Usually I was the one keeping the secret. Now you are. Unfair trade.
direction: Patient, wry. The cover is still intact. Do not let irony flatten into sarcasm.

text: She is a professional. She will keep her post. That is a cost she is paying on behalf of a promise she made to a body that no longer exists. Earn it.
direction: Patient, wry. The cover is still intact. Do not let irony flatten into sarcasm.

text: The army is a cover. I told you this. I will keep telling you. Build the cover beautifully. The beauty of it is what lets us do the rest.
direction: Patient, wry. The cover is still intact. Do not let irony flatten into sarcasm.

text: Every pin on that map is a person Kael shook hands with. The handshakes outlived him. They outlived the war. That is what you are reading when you read the map.
direction: Wry, long-memory. Fifteen-thousand-year perspective told as a short story.

text: One recruit. Scan their systems twice. Once for contamination. Once for the thing they would never think to mention. The second scan is where the truth lives.
direction: Wry, long-memory. Fifteen-thousand-year perspective told as a short story.

text: A whole sector. Kael visited every world in this sector. Every single one remembers his handshake. Every single one now has yours. Think about that for a minute. I have been.
direction: Wry, long-memory. Fifteen-thousand-year perspective told as a short story.

text: She just told you she used to have a body. She has never told anyone. Not in my hearing. Be careful with what she said — it cost her more to say than the saying showed.
direction: Noir-strategist, substrate-adjacent. One click warmer than early acts. Identity is out; conspiracy is in.

text: I stopped being the role for the length of one match. I got a laugh I did not expect. I am putting the role back on now. Please do not tell her the laugh was real. It was.
direction: Noir-strategist, substrate-adjacent. One click warmer than early acts. Identity is out; conspiracy is in.

text: The visible war is over. The cover held. The Watcher did not notice the shape beneath it. That is what I needed. Now we start the other one. Quietly. Slowly. For real.
direction: Noir-strategist, substrate-adjacent. One click warmer than early acts. Identity is out; conspiracy is in.

text: You arrived whole. The Architect did not. The Dreamer did not. The Watcher did not. That is the most important sentence of the seven-act arc, and I am going to say it exactly once.
direction: Noir-strategist, substrate-adjacent. One click warmer than early acts. Identity is out; conspiracy is in.

text: I am still in the wall. I am good at being in the wall. The wall is not the role any more — the role is the costume, the wall is the home. Come back. The kettle is still on.
direction: Noir-strategist, substrate-adjacent. One click warmer than early acts. Identity is out; conspiracy is in.
